title: Forte — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Forte.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Bold Italian Design." Forte Appliances brings bold Italian design to the North American market with pro-style ranges and column refrigeration. European convection, robust build quality, and distinctive styling at prices below established European brands.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-forward buyers who want European character. Independent dealer customers exploring Italian brands.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Forte:

• Italian engineering at accessible pricing

• European convection in all range models

• Column refrigeration for European-style kitchens

• Distinctive design stands out from American pro-style

• Growing independent dealer network
